name: Takigawa Kasumi
source:
Protagonist childhood friend and owner of hot spring. Often acted as his big sister when came to visit. After getting a call from protagonist father decide to offer him a job. 

[spoiler] Was previously married for a short while. Tried to please her husband with sexual acts but instead thought of her as slut. Since then she liked sex but was scared to get close to another man again fearing they reject her because she likes sex. [/spoiler]
